measurement: Replacement calf liner for the Ossur Rebound Cartilage knee brace. This SKU is the Right Medial/Left Lateral (RM/LL) version. Use it with a brace worn on the right leg for medial unloading or on the left leg for lateral unloading. Check the configuration on the brace label before ordering. Confirm your brace configuration (Right Medial or Left Lateral) on the brace label or your order paperwork. The liner matches the calf shell of the Rebound Cartilage brace, so no body measurement is required. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
